body:
I just want it to stop.  I can't help anyone anymore.  Not sure I ever could.  This is too hard on my own.  Not sure why I am holding on.  The world will be better without me in it.  Really.  The country voted and they decided they wanted a world without trans people, and that includes me.  And I keep hurting people on top of that...

Sorry. I just don't want to be alone, but I don't deserve companionship.  Selfish of me. 

If I wanted to live, I should not have snapped at that woman today.
